name: BloodBowl_Card
cardText:
Frenzy, Horns, Loner (4+), 
Mighty Blow, Thick Skull, Unchannelled Fury
specialRules: Gored by the Bull: Once per game wen Grashnak performs a Block Action as part of a Blitz Action, he may roll one additional Block Dice against the opposition player regardless of their ST, to a maximum of three Block Dice. If Grashnak performs a second Block Action due to the Frenzy Skill, the second Block Action will also benefit from this rule.
